title: WS-137: may the stand carry an offline copy of a company's demo pack, outside its vault?
detail: The venue allows no hotspots. The pack itself is a vault per company (GetVocal AI, PolyAI, Feedzai, Legora) with a read key a person passes on, test data only until security clears real keys.
recommend: Yes, on the team laptop only, holding test data, deleted after the summit
options: Yes, on the team laptop only
